sentence: That timeline runs alongside a finding this site has already documented on the elements side of the same checklist: [the vocabulary used to describe line, shape and colour varies across teaching systems, and one available 1968 textbook does not establish its origin](/elements-of-art/), decades after Ross and Dow had already published competing, incompatible versions of the principles half of the same subject.

sentence: A comparable lag turns up in an unrelated corner of art vocabulary: [mandala can name divisions of Vedic hymns as well as later Buddhist ritual images](/mandala-art/), but hymn composition dates do not date the first use of the label or the first image. \"Emphasis\" isn't a fabricated concept, painters have directed a viewer's eye toward one part of a picture for as long as there have been pictures, but these particular textbooks show different ways of naming the device.
